file.content:
Three-panel academic figure for a TOP-venue robotics paper (CoRL/NeurIPS level). Full width, figsize (14, 5) inches, 300 DPI. White background throughout.

OVERALL STYLE:
- Publication quality for a TOP venue (CoRL/NeurIPS/ICML)
- Elegant, premium, sophisticated — NOT cheap or homework-like
- Subtle drop shadows (2px offset, 8% opacity) on all boxes
- Rounded corners (10px) on all rectangles
- Thin, elegant arrow heads — not bulky matplotlib defaults
- Serif font (Times New Roman) for panel labels and titles, sans-serif (Helvetica) for body text and annotations
- Muted, harmonious color palette — NO saturated primary colors, NO matplotlib default colors
- Generous white space between elements (wspace=0.08)
- Consistent visual weight across all panels
- Panel labels '(a)', '(b)', '(c)' in 12pt bold serif at top-left of each panel
- NO matplotlib default styling: NO gray background, NO thick gridlines, NO tab10 colors, NO default spines

========================================
Panel (a) "ACR-VLA Pipeline" (left, ~48% width):
========================================

Horizontal pipeline flowchart from left to right showing the complete ACR-VLA inference process.

Components (left to right, all boxes are rounded rectangles with 10px corners):

1. "Robot Observation" box: light warm gray (#F5F6F7) fill, thin border (#BDC3C7, 1.2pt), contains a small camera icon or image placeholder. Size: 1.8cm wide x 1.5cm tall. Centered text "Observation" in 9pt sans-serif.

2. Arrow (thin, elegant, #7F8C8D, 1pt) pointing right.

3. "Frozen VLA" box: large, prominent. Fill: steel blue (#D6E4F0). Border: navy (#2C3E50, 1.5pt). Size: 3cm wide x 2.5cm tall. Text layout:
   - Title "Frozen VLA" in 11pt bold serif, navy color
   - Subtitle "0.4–3.6B params" in 8pt sans-serif, gray (#7F8C8D)
   - Small lock icon or snowflake symbol indicating "frozen"
   - A subtle "NO gradient" annotation in 7pt italic gray below

4. Arrow pointing right, splits into K=2 parallel thin arrows (dashed, #7F8C8D).

5. "K Action Candidates" region: two small action vector boxes stacked vertically, each 1.2cm x 0.6cm:
   - Top box: light coral fill (#FADBD8), text "a_1" in 9pt
   - Bottom box: light teal fill (#D5F5E3), text "a_2" in 9pt
   - Label "K=2 samples" in 8pt gray below

6. Arrow pointing right, converges.

7. "Argmin Centering" box: light yellow (#FEF9E7) fill, border (#F39C12, 1.2pt). Size: 2cm x 1.5cm. Text "Argmin" in 10pt, subtitle "select closest to mean" in 7pt gray. A small mathematical annotation: "argmin_i ||a_i - a_bar||" in 8pt italic.

8. Arrow pointing right.

9. "CRM" box: warm accent color, fill (#FDEBD0), border (#E67E22, 1.5pt). Size: 2cm x 1.8cm. Text layout:
   - "CRM" in 11pt bold serif, color #E67E22
   - "615K params" in 8pt sans-serif gray
   - "1.8 MB" in 7pt gray
   An upward arrow from below labeled "obs features" in 8pt gray, connecting from the VLA box (showing feature reuse).

10. Arrow pointing right, with a small "+" symbol and "residual delta_a" annotation in 8pt gray.

11. "Refined Action" box: soft green fill (#D5F5E3), border (#27AE60, 1.5pt). Size: 1.8cm x 1.5cm. Text "Refined Action" in 10pt serif.

Between VLA and CRM, draw a thin dashed curved arrow (gray, 0.8pt) from VLA bottom to CRM bottom, labeled "obs features" in 7pt italic gray. This shows CRM uses VLA's internal representations.

========================================
Panel (b) "Adaptive Gating" (right top, ~26% width):
========================================

Decision diagram showing the adaptive K mechanism.

Top: A diamond decision node with text "L2 distance" in 9pt. Fill: very light gray (#FAFAFA). Border: navy (#2C3E50, 1.2pt). Size: 2cm x 1.5cm.

Below the diamond, the L2 formula: "d = ||a_1 - a_2||_2" in 9pt italic serif.

Two branches from the diamond:

LEFT branch (L2 > tau):
- Arrow going down-left, label "d > tau" in 8pt bold, color academic red (#C0392B)
- Rounded box: fill (#FADBD8), border (#C0392B, 1.2pt). Text:
  - "VLA Uncertain" in 9pt bold, red
  - "Apply CRM correction" in 8pt gray
  - Icon or symbol: exclamation mark

RIGHT branch (L2 <= tau):
- Arrow going down-right, label "d <= tau" in 8pt bold, color green (#27AE60)
- Rounded box: fill (#D5F5E3), border (#27AE60, 1.2pt). Text:
  - "VLA Confident" in 9pt bold, green
  - "Use argmin directly" in 8pt gray
  - Icon or symbol: checkmark

Below both boxes, a subtle annotation: "tau calibrated on held-out demos" in 7pt italic gray.

========================================
Panel (c) "Gating Effect" (right bottom, ~26% width):
========================================

Scatter plot showing trigger_rate vs improvement (delta SR) for 4 LIBERO suites.

Axes:
- X-axis: "Trigger Rate (%)" range 2–9, label in 9pt serif
- Y-axis: "delta SR (pp)" range -1.0 to +3.0, label in 9pt serif
- Only left and bottom spines, thin (#BDC3C7, 0.8pt)
- Light horizontal gridlines only (#F0F0F0, 0.5pt)

Data points (large circles, 120pt marker size, white fill with colored edge, edge width 2pt):
- Spatial: x=7.8, y=+2.1, edge color #2C3E50 (navy), label "Spatial" in 8pt
- Goal: x=5.2, y=+1.3, edge color #2980B9 (blue), label "Goal" in 8pt
- Object: x=3.2, y=+0.1, edge color #E67E22 (orange), label "Object" in 8pt
- Long: x=3.8, y=-0.3, edge color #C0392B (red), label "Long" in 8pt

Labels placed directly next to each point (no legend box needed).

A vertical dashed line at x=5.0 (thin, gray #BDC3C7, 0.8pt), with annotation on each side:
- Left side: "Confident suites" in 7pt italic gray
- Right side: "Uncertain suites" in 7pt italic gray

A subtle trend: points to the right (higher trigger rate) have higher improvement. The visual story is: "gating correctly modulates intervention intensity."

Title above: "Gating Modulates Intervention" in 10pt serif bold.

========================================
FORBIDDEN:
- NO matplotlib default colors (tab10, tab20)
- NO gray plot background
- NO thick axis lines
- NO legend boxes with borders
- NO Comic Sans or monospace fonts
- NO 3D effects
- NO gratuitous gradients
- NO clipart-style icons
========================================

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate ACR-VLA Figure 1 version A (information-dense) with matplotlib."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# ── Colors ──
C = {
    'bg': '#FFFFFF',
    'navy': '#2C3E50',
    'steel': '#D6E4F0',
    'gray_border': '#BDC3C7',
    'gray_text': '#7F8C8D',
    'gray_light': '#F5F6F7',
    'yellow': '#FEF9E7',
    'yellow_border': '#F39C12',
    'orange_fill': '#FDEBD0',
    'orange': '#E67E22',
    'green_fill': '#D5F5E3',
    'green': '#27AE60',
    'coral': '#FADBD8',
    'red': '#C0392B',
    'blue': '#2980B9',
    'grid': '#F0F0F0',
    'spine': '#BDC3C7',
}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 4.8), dpi=300, facecolor=C['bg'])

# Layout: panel (a) left 53%, panels (b)+(c) right 45%
# Using gridspec for precise control
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[1.15, 0.85], height_ratios=[1, 1],
                      wspace=0.06, hspace=0.15,
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.94, bottom=0.04)

ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])  # panel (a) spans both rows
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])  # panel (b) top-right
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])  # panel (c) bottom-right

for ax in [ax_a, ax_b]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
    ax.set_aspect('equal')
    ax.axis('off')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel (a) — ACR-VLA Pipeline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_a

def add_rounded_box(ax, xy, w, h, fill, edge, lw=1.2, zorder=3):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(xy, w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.12",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw,
                         zorder=zorder, mutation_scale=0.5)
    # subtle shadow
    shadow = FancyBboxPatch((xy[0]+0.04, xy[1]-0.04), w, h,
                            boxstyle="round,pad=0.12",
                            facecolor='#00000008', edgecolor='none',
                            zorder=zorder-1, mutation_scale=0.5)
    ax.add_patch(shadow)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    return box

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate ACR-VLA Figure 1 version A (information-dense) with matplotlib."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# ── Colors ──
C = {
    'bg': '#FFFFFF',
    'navy': '#2C3E50',
    'steel': '#D6E4F0',
    'gray_border': '#BDC3C7',
    'gray_text': '#7F8C8D',
    'gray_light': '#F5F6F7',
    'yellow': '#FEF9E7',
    'yellow_border': '#F39C12',
    'orange_fill': '#FDEBD0',
    'orange': '#E67E22',
    'green_fill': '#D5F5E3',
    'green': '#27AE60',
    'coral': '#FADBD8',
    'red': '#C0392B',
    'blue': '#2980B9',
    'grid': '#F0F0F0',
    'spine': '#BDC3C7',
}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5.2), dpi=300, facecolor=C['bg'])

# Layout: panel (a) left ~55%, panels (b)+(c) right ~42%
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[1.2, 0.8], height_ratios=[1, 1.05],
                      wspace=0.08, hspace=0.25,
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.95, bottom=0.06)

ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ── Helpers ──
def draw_box(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, edge, lw=1.2, zorder=3):
    """Draw a rounded box centered at (cx, cy)."""
    box = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw,
                         zorder=zorder)
    shadow = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2 + 0.15, cy - h/2 - 0.15), w, h,
                            boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                            facecolor='#00000010', edgecolor='none',
                            zorder=zorder-1)
    ax.add_patch(shadow)
    ax.add_patch(box)

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=None, lw=1.2, ls='-', hw=0.15, hl=0.25):
    if color is None:
        color = C['gray_text']
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle=f'->,head_width={hw},head_length={hl}',
                               color=color, lw=lw, linestyle=ls),
                zorder=4)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel (a) — ACR-VLA Pipeline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_a
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 20.5)
ax.set_ylim(-3, 7)
ax.axis('off')

# Panel label + title
ax.text(-0.3, 6.5, '(a)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',
        color=C['navy'], va='top')
ax.text(8, 6.5, 'ACR-VLA Pipeline', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], va='top', ha='center')

cy = 2.5  # main pipeline center y

# 1. Obs box
obs_cx, obs_cy = 1.0, cy
draw_box(ax, obs_cx, obs_cy, 1.6, 1.5, C['gray_light'], C['gray_border'])
ax.text(obs_cx, obs_cy + 0.15, '⬜', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(obs_cx, obs_cy - 0.25, 'Obs', fontsize=9, ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=C['navy'], zorder=5, fontweight='bold')

draw_arrow(ax, 1.85, cy, 2.75, cy)

# 2. Frozen VLA box
vla_cx = 4.3
draw_box(ax, vla_cx, cy, 2.8, 2.6, C['steel'], C['navy'], lw=1.8)
ax.text(vla_cx, cy + 0.65, 'Frozen VLA', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(vla_cx, cy + 0.05, '❄', fontsize=9, ha='center', va='center', zorder=5,
        path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=0, foreground='white')])
ax.text(vla_cx, cy - 0.5, '0.4–3.6B params', fontsize=7,
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(vla_cx, cy - 1.7, 'NO gradient', fontsize=7,
        fontstyle='italic', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='top', zorder=5)

# 3. K=2 sampling split

k_bot_y = cy - 0.8

# Dashed arrows VLA → a1, a2

draw_arrow(ax, 5.75, cy - 0.3, k_cx - 0.55, k_bot_y, ls='--', lw=0.9)

# a1 box
draw_box(ax, k_cx, k_top_y, 0.9, 0.7, C['coral'], '#D4A0A0', lw=0.8)

        color=C['red'], zorder=5)

# a2 box
draw_box(ax, k_cx, k_bot_y, 0.9, 0.7, C['green_fill'], '#A0C8A0', lw=0.8)
ax.text(k_cx, k_bot_y, '$a_2$', fontsize=10, ha='center', va='center',
        color=C['green'], zorder=5)

# K=2 label
ax.text(k_cx + 0.7, cy + 1.55, '$K$=2', fontsize=7.5,
        color=C['gray_text'], ha='left', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=5)

# 4. Arrows a1,a2 → Argmin
argmin_cx = 9.4

draw_arrow(ax, k_cx + 0.5, k_bot_y, argmin_cx - 1.0, cy - 0.15, ls='--', lw=0.9)

ax.text(argmin_cx, cy - 0.25, r'$\arg\min_i \|a_i\!-\!\bar{a}\|$',

        ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)

# 5. Arrow Argmin → CRM

# CRM box

ax.text(crm_cx, cy - 0.35, '1.8 MB', fontsize=6.5, color=C['gray_text'],

ax.text((crm_cx + ref_cx) / 2, cy + 0.35, r'$+\;\delta_a$', fontsize=8,
        color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=5)

# Refined Action box
draw_box(ax, ref_cx, cy, 1.8, 1.4, C['green_fill'], C['green'], lw=1.5)

ax.annotate('', xy=(crm_cx, cy - 1.0),

ax.text((vla_cx + crm_cx) / 2, cy - 2.3, 'obs features', fontsize=7,

ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
ax.set_ylim(0, 10)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate ACR-VLA Figure 1 version A (information-dense) with matplotlib."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# ── Colors ──
C = {
    'bg': '#FFFFFF',
    'navy': '#2C3E50',
    'steel': '#D6E4F0',
    'gray_border': '#BDC3C7',
    'gray_text': '#7F8C8D',
    'gray_light': '#F5F6F7',
    'yellow': '#FEF9E7',
    'yellow_border': '#F39C12',
    'orange_fill': '#FDEBD0',
    'orange': '#E67E22',
    'green_fill': '#D5F5E3',
    'green': '#27AE60',
    'coral': '#FADBD8',
    'red': '#C0392B',
    'blue': '#2980B9',
    'grid': '#F0F0F0',
    'spine': '#BDC3C7',
}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5.2), dpi=300, facecolor=C['bg'])

# Layout: panel (a) left ~55%, panels (b)+(c) right ~42%
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[1.2, 0.8], height_ratios=[1, 1.05],
                      wspace=0.08, hspace=0.25,
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.95, bottom=0.06)

ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ── Helpers ──
def draw_box(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, edge, lw=1.2, zorder=3):
    """Draw a rounded box centered at (cx, cy)."""
    box = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw,
                         zorder=zorder)
    shadow = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2 + 0.15, cy - h/2 - 0.15), w, h,
                            boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                            facecolor='#00000010', edgecolor='none',
                            zorder=zorder-1)
    ax.add_patch(shadow)
    ax.add_patch(box)

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=None, lw=1.2, ls='-', hw=0.15, hl=0.25):
    if color is None:
        color = C['gray_text']
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle=f'->,head_width={hw},head_length={hl}',
                               color=color, lw=lw, linestyle=ls),
                zorder=4)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel (a) — ACR-VLA Pipeline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_a
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 20.5)
ax.set_ylim(-3, 7)
ax.axis('off')

# Panel label + title
ax.text(-0.3, 6.5, '(a)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',
        color=C['navy'], va='top')
ax.text(8, 6.5, 'ACR-VLA Pipeline', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], va='top', ha='center')

cy = 2.5  # main pipeline center y

# 1. Obs box
obs_cx, obs_cy = 1.0, cy
draw_box(ax, obs_cx, obs_cy, 1.6, 1.5, C['gray_light'], C['gray_border'])
ax.text(obs_cx, obs_cy + 0.15, '⬜', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(obs_cx, obs_cy - 0.25, 'Obs', fontsize=9, ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=C['navy'], zorder=5, fontweight='bold')

# Arrow Obs → VLA
draw_arrow(ax, 1.85, cy, 2.75, cy)

# 2. Frozen VLA box
vla_cx = 4.3
draw_box(ax, vla_cx, cy, 2.8, 2.6, C['steel'], C['navy'], lw=1.8)
ax.text(vla_cx, cy + 0.65, 'Frozen VLA', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(vla_cx, cy + 0.05, '❄', fontsize=9, ha='center', va='center', zorder=5,
        path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=0, foreground='white')])
ax.text(vla_cx, cy - 0.5, '0.4–3.6B params', fontsize=7,
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(vla_cx, cy - 1.7, 'NO gradient', fontsize=7,
        fontstyle='italic', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='top', zorder=5)

# 3. K=2 sampling split
k_cx = 7.0
k_top_y = cy + 0.8
k_bot_y = cy - 0.8

# Dashed arrows VLA → a1, a2
draw_arrow(ax, 5.75, cy + 0.3, k_cx - 0.55, k_top_y, ls='--', lw=0.9)
draw_arrow(ax, 5.75, cy - 0.3, k_cx - 0.55, k_bot_y, ls='--', lw=0.9)

# a1 box
draw_box(ax, k_cx, k_top_y, 0.9, 0.7, C['coral'], '#D4A0A0', lw=0.8)
ax.text(k_cx, k_top_y, '$a_1$', fontsize=10, ha='center', va='center',
        color=C['red'], zorder=5)

# a2 box
draw_box(ax, k_cx, k_bot_y, 0.9, 0.7, C['green_fill'], '#A0C8A0', lw=0.8)
ax.text(k_cx, k_bot_y, '$a_2$', fontsize=10, ha='center', va='center',
        color=C['green'], zorder=5)

# K=2 label
ax.text(k_cx + 0.7, cy + 1.55, '$K$=2', fontsize=7.5,
        color=C['gray_text'], ha='left', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=5)

# 4. Arrows a1,a2 → Argmin
argmin_cx = 9.4
draw_arrow(ax, k_cx + 0.5, k_top_y, argmin_cx - 1.0, cy + 0.15, ls='--', lw=0.9)
draw_arrow(ax, k_cx + 0.5, k_bot_y, argmin_cx - 1.0, cy - 0.15, ls='--', lw=0.9)

# Argmin box
draw_box(ax, argmin_cx, cy, 1.9, 1.7, C['yellow'], C['yellow_border'])
ax.text(argmin_cx, cy + 0.35, 'Argmin', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color='#9A7D0A', ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(argmin_cx, cy - 0.25, r'$\arg\min_i \|a_i\!-\!\bar{a}\|$',
        fontsize=7, color=C['gray_text'],
        ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)

# 5. Arrow Argmin → CRM
crm_cx = 12.6
draw_arrow(ax, argmin_cx + 1.0, cy, crm_cx - 1.0, cy)

# CRM box
draw_box(ax, crm_cx, cy, 1.8, 1.9, C['orange_fill'], C['orange'], lw=1.8)
ax.text(crm_cx, cy + 0.5, 'CRM', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['orange'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(crm_cx, cy, '615K params', fontsize=6.5, color=C['gray_text'],
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=5)
ax.text(crm_cx, cy - 0.35, '1.8 MB', fontsize=6.5, color=C['gray_text'],
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=5)

# 6. Arrow CRM → Refined Action with + δ_a
ref_cx = 15.8
draw_arrow(ax, crm_cx + 0.95, cy, ref_cx - 1.0, cy)
ax.text((crm_cx + ref_cx) / 2, cy + 0.35, r'$+\;\delta_a$', fontsize=8,
        color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=5)

# Refined Action box
draw_box(ax, ref_cx, cy, 1.8, 1.4, C['green_fill'], C['green'], lw=1.5)
ax.text(ref_cx, cy + 0.15, 'Refined', fontsize=9, fontfamily='serif',
        color=C['green'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5, fontweight='bold')
ax.text(ref_cx, cy - 0.25, 'Action', fontsize=9, fontfamily='serif',
        color=C['green'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5, fontweight='bold')

# obs features dashed arc from VLA bottom to CRM bottom
ax.annotate('', xy=(crm_cx, cy - 1.0),
            xytext=(vla_cx, cy - 1.35),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->,head_width=0.12,head_length=0.2',
                           color=C['gray_text'], lw=0.8, linestyle='--',
                           connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.35'),
            zorder=2)
ax.text((vla_cx + crm_cx) / 2, cy - 2.3, 'obs features', fontsize=7,
        fontstyle='italic', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='top', zorder=5)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel (b) — Adaptive Gating
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_b
ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
ax.axis('off')

# Panel label + title
ax.text(0.2, 9.7, '(b)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',
        color=C['navy'], va='top')
ax.text(5.0, 9.7, 'Adaptive Gating', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], va='top', ha='center')

# Diamond
d_cx, d_cy = 5.0, 7.0
d_r = 1.0
diamond = plt.Polygon([
    (d_cx, d_cy + d_r * 1.1),
    (d_cx + d_r * 1.4, d_cy),
    (d_cx, d_cy - d_r * 1.1),
    (d_cx - d_r * 1.4, d_cy)
], closed=True, facecolor='#FAFAFA', edgecolor=C['navy'], linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
ax.add_patch(diamond)
ax.text(d_cx, d_cy + 0.25, 'L2 dist', fontsize=8.5, ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=C['navy'], zorder=5, fontweight='bold')
ax.text(d_cx, d_cy - 0.3, r'$d=\|a_1\!-\!a_2\|_2$', fontsize=7,
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)

# LEFT branch: d > τ
l_cx, l_cy = 2.5, 3.0
draw_arrow(ax, d_cx - d_r * 1.4 - 0.15, d_cy - 0.5,
           l_cx + 1.2, l_cy + 1.0, color=C['red'], lw=1.3)
ax.text(d_cx - d_r * 1.4 - 0.5, d_cy + 0.1,
        r'$d\!>\!\tau$', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=C['red'],
        ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)

draw_box(ax, l_cx + 0.5, l_cy + 0.4, 2.8, 1.6, C['coral'], C['red'], lw=1.2)

        fontweight='bold', color=C['red'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)

# RIGHT branch: d ≤ τ

#!/usr/bin/env python3

import matplotlib

from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Polygon

                      wspace=0.08, hspace=0.22,
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.95, bottom=0.06)

ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])

    box = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, zorder=zorder)
    shadow = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2 + 0.12, cy - h/2 - 0.12), w, h,

                            facecolor='#00000008', edgecolor='none', zorder=zorder-1)
    ax.add_patch(shadow)
    ax.add_patch(box)

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=None, lw=1.2, ls='-'):
    if color is None:
        color = C['gray_text']

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate ACR-VLA Figure 1 version A (information-dense) with matplotlib."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Polygon
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# ── Colors ──
C = {
    'bg': '#FFFFFF',
    'navy': '#2C3E50',
    'steel': '#D6E4F0',
    'gray_border': '#BDC3C7',
    'gray_text': '#7F8C8D',
    'gray_light': '#F5F6F7',
    'yellow': '#FEF9E7',
    'yellow_border': '#F39C12',
    'orange_fill': '#FDEBD0',
    'orange': '#E67E22',
    'green_fill': '#D5F5E3',
    'green': '#27AE60',
    'coral': '#FADBD8',
    'red': '#C0392B',
    'blue': '#2980B9',
    'grid': '#F0F0F0',
    'spine': '#BDC3C7',
}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5.5), dpi=300, facecolor=C['bg'])

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[1.2, 0.8], height_ratios=[1, 1.1],
                      wspace=0.08, hspace=0.22,
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.95, bottom=0.06)

ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])


def draw_box(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, edge, lw=1.2, zorder=3):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, zorder=zorder)
    shadow = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2 + 0.12, cy - h/2 - 0.12), w, h,
                            boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                            facecolor='#00000008', edgecolor='none', zorder=zorder-1)
    ax.add_patch(shadow)
    ax.add_patch(box)

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=None, lw=1.2, ls='-'):
    if color is None:
        color = C['gray_text']
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->,head_width=0.15,head_length=0.2',
                               color=color, lw=lw, linestyle=ls), zorder=4)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel (a) — ACR-VLA Pipeline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_a
ax.set_xlim(-1, 21)
ax.set_ylim(-3.5, 7.5)
ax.axis('off')

ax.text(-0.5, 7.0, '(a)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',
        color=C['navy'], va='top')
ax.text(8.5, 7.0, 'ACR-VLA Pipeline', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], va='top', ha='center')

cy = 2.8

# 1. Obs
obs_cx = 0.8
draw_box(ax, obs_cx, cy, 1.6, 1.6, C['gray_light'], C['gray_border'])
# Camera icon via simple shapes
ax.plot([obs_cx-0.3, obs_cx+0.3, obs_cx+0.3, obs_cx-0.3, obs_cx-0.3],
        [cy+0.35, cy+0.35, cy-0.05, cy-0.05, cy+0.35],
        color=C['gray_text'], lw=0.8, zorder=5)
ax.plot([obs_cx-0.1, obs_cx+0.1], [cy+0.45, cy+0.45],
        color=C['gray_text'], lw=0.8, zorder=5)
ax.add_patch(plt.Circle((obs_cx, cy+0.15), 0.12, fill=False,
             edgecolor=C['gray_text'], lw=0.6, zorder=5))
ax.text(obs_cx, cy - 0.45, 'Obs', fontsize=9.5, ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=C['navy'], zorder=5, fontweight='bold')

# Arrow Obs → VLA
draw_arrow(ax, obs_cx + 0.85, cy, 2.65, cy)

# 2. Frozen VLA
vla_cx = 4.3

# 3. K=2 samples

draw_box(ax, k_cx, k_bot_y, 0.9, 0.75, C['green_fill'], '#82C99A', lw=0.8)

ax.text(k_cx, cy + 1.75, r'$K\!=\!2$', fontsize=8,
        color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=5)

# 4. Arrows samples → Argmin
argmin_cx = 10.0
draw_arrow(ax, k_cx + 0.5, k_top_y, argmin_cx - 1.05, cy + 0.15, ls='--', lw=0.9)
draw_arrow(ax, k_cx + 0.5, k_bot_y, argmin_cx - 1.05, cy - 0.15, ls='--', lw=0.9)

# Argmin box

ax.text(argmin_cx, cy - 0.25, r'$\arg\min_i \|a_i\!-\!\bar{a}\|$',
        fontsize=7.5, color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)

# 5. Arrow Argmin → CRM
crm_cx = 13.2

# CRM box

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate ACR-VLA Figure 1 version A (information-dense) with matplotlib."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Polygon
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# ── Colors ──
C = {
    'bg': '#FFFFFF',
    'navy': '#2C3E50',
    'steel': '#D6E4F0',
    'gray_border': '#BDC3C7',
    'gray_text': '#7F8C8D',
    'gray_light': '#F5F6F7',
    'yellow': '#FEF9E7',
    'yellow_border': '#F39C12',
    'orange_fill': '#FDEBD0',
    'orange': '#E67E22',
    'green_fill': '#D5F5E3',
    'green': '#27AE60',
    'coral': '#FADBD8',
    'red': '#C0392B',
    'blue': '#2980B9',
    'grid': '#F0F0F0',
    'spine': '#BDC3C7',
}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5.5), dpi=300, facecolor=C['bg'])

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[1.2, 0.8], height_ratios=[1, 1.1],
                      wspace=0.08, hspace=0.22,
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.95, bottom=0.06)

ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])


def draw_box(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, edge, lw=1.2, zorder=3):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, zorder=zorder)
    shadow = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2 + 0.12, cy - h/2 - 0.12), w, h,
                            boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                            facecolor='#00000008', edgecolor='none', zorder=zorder-1)
    ax.add_patch(shadow)
    ax.add_patch(box)

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=None, lw=1.2, ls='-'):
    if color is None:
        color = C['gray_text']
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->,head_width=0.15,head_length=0.2',
                               color=color, lw=lw, linestyle=ls), zorder=4)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel (a) — ACR-VLA Pipeline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_a
ax.set_xlim(-1, 21)
ax.set_ylim(-3.5, 7.5)
ax.axis('off')

ax.text(-0.5, 7.0, '(a)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',
        color=C['navy'], va='top')
ax.text(8.5, 7.0, 'ACR-VLA Pipeline', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], va='top', ha='center')

cy = 2.8

# 1. Obs
obs_cx = 0.8
draw_box(ax, obs_cx, cy, 1.6, 1.6, C['gray_light'], C['gray_border'])
# Camera icon via simple shapes
ax.plot([obs_cx-0.3, obs_cx+0.3, obs_cx+0.3, obs_cx-0.3, obs_cx-0.3],
        [cy+0.35, cy+0.35, cy-0.05, cy-0.05, cy+0.35],
        color=C['gray_text'], lw=0.8, zorder=5)
ax.plot([obs_cx-0.1, obs_cx+0.1], [cy+0.45, cy+0.45],
        color=C['gray_text'], lw=0.8, zorder=5)
ax.add_patch(plt.Circle((obs_cx, cy+0.15), 0.12, fill=False,
             edgecolor=C['gray_text'], lw=0.6, zorder=5))
ax.text(obs_cx, cy - 0.45, 'Obs', fontsize=9.5, ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=C['navy'], zorder=5, fontweight='bold')

# Arrow Obs → VLA
draw_arrow(ax, obs_cx + 0.85, cy, 2.65, cy)

# 2. Frozen VLA
vla_cx = 4.3
draw_box(ax, vla_cx, cy, 2.8, 2.8, C['steel'], C['navy'], lw=1.8)
ax.text(vla_cx, cy + 0.75, 'Frozen VLA', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
# Snowflake via six-armed star pattern
_sf_r = 0.22
_sf_cx, _sf_cy = vla_cx + 1.05, cy + 0.75
for angle in [0, 60, 120]:
    rad = np.radians(angle)
    dx, dy = _sf_r * np.cos(rad), _sf_r * np.sin(rad)
    ax.plot([_sf_cx - dx, _sf_cx + dx], [_sf_cy - dy, _sf_cy + dy],
            color='#5B9BD5', lw=1.2, zorder=5, solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(vla_cx, cy + 0.05, '0.4 – 3.6B params', fontsize=7.5,
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
# Lock icon (simple rectangle + arc)
lock_x, lock_y = vla_cx, cy - 0.55
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((lock_x-0.15, lock_y-0.15), 0.3, 0.22,
             boxstyle="round,pad=0.02", facecolor=C['navy'], edgecolor=C['navy'],
             linewidth=0.5, zorder=5))
ax.add_patch(plt.matplotlib.patches.Arc((lock_x, lock_y+0.07), 0.2, 0.2,
             angle=0, theta1=0, theta2=180, edgecolor=C['navy'], lw=0.8, zorder=5))
ax.text(vla_cx, cy - 1.8, 'NO gradient', fontsize=7.5,
        fontstyle='italic', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='top', zorder=5)

# 3. K=2 samples
k_cx = 7.2
k_top_y = cy + 1.0
k_bot_y = cy - 1.0
draw_arrow(ax, 5.75, cy + 0.3, k_cx - 0.55, k_top_y, ls='--', lw=0.9)
draw_arrow(ax, 5.75, cy - 0.3, k_cx - 0.55, k_bot_y, ls='--', lw=0.9)

draw_box(ax, k_cx, k_top_y, 0.9, 0.75, C['coral'], '#D4A0A0', lw=0.8)
ax.text(k_cx, k_top_y, r'$a_1$', fontsize=10.5, ha='center', va='center',
        color='#A93226', zorder=5)

draw_box(ax, k_cx, k_bot_y, 0.9, 0.75, C['green_fill'], '#82C99A', lw=0.8)
ax.text(k_cx, k_bot_y, r'$a_2$', fontsize=10.5, ha='center', va='center',
        color='#1E8449', zorder=5)

ax.text(k_cx, cy + 1.75, r'$K\!=\!2$', fontsize=8,
        color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=5)

# 4. Arrows samples → Argmin
argmin_cx = 10.0
draw_arrow(ax, k_cx + 0.5, k_top_y, argmin_cx - 1.05, cy + 0.15, ls='--', lw=0.9)
draw_arrow(ax, k_cx + 0.5, k_bot_y, argmin_cx - 1.05, cy - 0.15, ls='--', lw=0.9)

# Argmin box
draw_box(ax, argmin_cx, cy, 2.0, 1.8, C['yellow'], C['yellow_border'])
ax.text(argmin_cx, cy + 0.4, 'Argmin', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color='#9A7D0A', ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(argmin_cx, cy - 0.25, r'$\arg\min_i \|a_i\!-\!\bar{a}\|$',
        fontsize=7.5, color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)

# 5. Arrow Argmin → CRM
crm_cx = 13.2
draw_arrow(ax, argmin_cx + 1.05, cy, crm_cx - 1.0, cy)

# CRM box
draw_box(ax, crm_cx, cy, 1.9, 2.0, C['orange_fill'], C['orange'], lw=1.8)
ax.text(crm_cx, cy + 0.55, 'CRM', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['orange'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(crm_cx, cy + 0.0, '615K params', fontsize=7, color=C['gray_text'],
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=5)
ax.text(crm_cx, cy - 0.4, '1.8 MB', fontsize=7, color=C['gray_text'],
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=5)

# 6. Arrow CRM → Refined Action
ref_cx = 16.5
draw_arrow(ax, crm_cx + 1.0, cy, ref_cx - 1.0, cy)
ax.text((crm_cx + ref_cx) / 2, cy + 0.35, r'$+\;\delta_a$', fontsize=8.5,
        color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=5)

# Refined Action box
draw_box(ax, ref_cx, cy, 1.9, 1.5, C['green_fill'], C['green'], lw=1.5)
ax.text(ref_cx, cy + 0.2, 'Refined', fontsize=9.5, fontfamily='serif',
        color='#1E8449', ha='center', va='center', zorder=5, fontweight='bold')
ax.text(ref_cx, cy - 0.25, 'Action', fontsize=9.5, fontfamily='serif',
        color='#1E8449', ha='center', va='center', zorder=5, fontweight='bold')

# obs features arc
ax.annotate('', xy=(crm_cx, cy - 1.05),
            xytext=(vla_cx, cy - 1.45),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->,head_width=0.12,head_length=0.18',
                           color=C['gray_text'], lw=0.8, linestyle='--',
                           connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.35'), zorder=2)
ax.text((vla_cx + crm_cx) / 2, cy - 2.5, 'obs features', fontsize=7.5,
        fontstyle='italic', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='top', zorder=5)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel (b) — Adaptive Gating
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_b
ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
ax.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)
ax.axis('off')

ax.text(0.15, 10.0, '(b)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',

ax.text(5.0, 10.0, 'Adaptive Gating', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], va='top', ha='center')

# Diamond
d_cx, d_cy = 5.0, 7.3
d_ry, d_rx = 1.2, 1.5
diamond = Polygon([
    (d_cx, d_cy + d_ry),
    (d_cx + d_rx, d_cy),
    (d_cx, d_cy - d_ry),
    (d_cx - d_rx, d_cy)
], closed=True, facecolor='#F8F9FA', edgecolor=C['navy'], linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
ax.add_patch(diamond)
ax.text(d_cx, d_cy + 0.35, 'L2 dist', fontsize=9, ha='center', va='center',

# LEFT: d > τ

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate ACR-VLA Figure 1 version A (information-dense) with matplotlib."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Polygon
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# ── Colors ──
C = {
    'bg': '#FFFFFF',
    'navy': '#2C3E50',
    'steel': '#D6E4F0',
    'gray_border': '#BDC3C7',
    'gray_text': '#7F8C8D',
    'gray_light': '#F5F6F7',
    'yellow': '#FEF9E7',
    'yellow_border': '#F39C12',
    'orange_fill': '#FDEBD0',
    'orange': '#E67E22',
    'green_fill': '#D5F5E3',
    'green': '#27AE60',
    'coral': '#FADBD8',
    'red': '#C0392B',
    'blue': '#2980B9',
    'grid': '#F0F0F0',
    'spine': '#BDC3C7',
}

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 5.5), dpi=300, facecolor=C['bg'])

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[1.2, 0.8], height_ratios=[1, 1.1],
                      wspace=0.08, hspace=0.22,
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.95, bottom=0.06)

ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])


def draw_box(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, edge, lw=1.2, zorder=3):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=edge, linewidth=lw, zorder=zorder)
    shadow = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2 + 0.12, cy - h/2 - 0.12), w, h,
                            boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                            facecolor='#00000008', edgecolor='none', zorder=zorder-1)
    ax.add_patch(shadow)
    ax.add_patch(box)

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=None, lw=1.2, ls='-'):
    if color is None:
        color = C['gray_text']
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->,head_width=0.15,head_length=0.2',
                               color=color, lw=lw, linestyle=ls), zorder=4)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel (a) — ACR-VLA Pipeline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_a
ax.set_xlim(-1, 21)
ax.set_ylim(-3.5, 7.5)
ax.axis('off')

ax.text(-0.5, 7.0, '(a)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',
        color=C['navy'], va='top')
ax.text(8.5, 7.0, 'ACR-VLA Pipeline', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], va='top', ha='center')

cy = 2.8

# 1. Obs
obs_cx = 0.8
draw_box(ax, obs_cx, cy, 1.6, 1.6, C['gray_light'], C['gray_border'])
# Camera icon via simple shapes
ax.plot([obs_cx-0.3, obs_cx+0.3, obs_cx+0.3, obs_cx-0.3, obs_cx-0.3],
        [cy+0.35, cy+0.35, cy-0.05, cy-0.05, cy+0.35],
        color=C['gray_text'], lw=0.8, zorder=5)
ax.plot([obs_cx-0.1, obs_cx+0.1], [cy+0.45, cy+0.45],
        color=C['gray_text'], lw=0.8, zorder=5)
ax.add_patch(plt.Circle((obs_cx, cy+0.15), 0.12, fill=False,
             edgecolor=C['gray_text'], lw=0.6, zorder=5))
ax.text(obs_cx, cy - 0.45, 'Obs', fontsize=9.5, ha='center', va='center',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=C['navy'], zorder=5, fontweight='bold')

# Arrow Obs → VLA
draw_arrow(ax, obs_cx + 0.85, cy, 2.65, cy)

# 2. Frozen VLA
vla_cx = 4.3
draw_box(ax, vla_cx, cy, 2.8, 2.8, C['steel'], C['navy'], lw=1.8)
ax.text(vla_cx, cy + 0.75, 'Frozen VLA', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
# Snowflake via six-armed star pattern
_sf_r = 0.22
_sf_cx, _sf_cy = vla_cx + 1.05, cy + 0.75
for angle in [0, 60, 120]:
    rad = np.radians(angle)
    dx, dy = _sf_r * np.cos(rad), _sf_r * np.sin(rad)
    ax.plot([_sf_cx - dx, _sf_cx + dx], [_sf_cy - dy, _sf_cy + dy],
            color='#5B9BD5', lw=1.2, zorder=5, solid_capstyle='round')
ax.text(vla_cx, cy + 0.05, '0.4 – 3.6B params', fontsize=7.5,
        fontfamily='sans-serif', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
# Lock icon (simple rectangle + arc)
lock_x, lock_y = vla_cx, cy - 0.55
ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((lock_x-0.15, lock_y-0.15), 0.3, 0.22,
             boxstyle="round,pad=0.02", facecolor=C['navy'], edgecolor=C['navy'],
             linewidth=0.5, zorder=5))
ax.add_patch(plt.matplotlib.patches.Arc((lock_x, lock_y+0.07), 0.2, 0.2,
             angle=0, theta1=0, theta2=180, edgecolor=C['navy'], lw=0.8, zorder=5))
ax.text(vla_cx, cy - 1.8, 'NO gradient', fontsize=7.5,
        fontstyle='italic', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='top', zorder=5)

# 3. K=2 samples
k_cx = 7.2
k_top_y = cy + 1.0
k_bot_y = cy - 1.0
draw_arrow(ax, 5.75, cy + 0.3, k_cx - 0.55, k_top_y, ls='--', lw=0.9)
draw_arrow(ax, 5.75, cy - 0.3, k_cx - 0.55, k_bot_y, ls='--', lw=0.9)

draw_box(ax, k_cx, k_top_y, 0.9, 0.75, C['coral'], '#D4A0A0', lw=0.8)
ax.text(k_cx, k_top_y, r'$a_1$', fontsize=10.5, ha='center', va='center',
        color='#A93226', zorder=5)

draw_box(ax, k_cx, k_bot_y, 0.9, 0.75, C['green_fill'], '#82C99A', lw=0.8)
ax.text(k_cx, k_bot_y, r'$a_2$', fontsize=10.5, ha='center', va='center',
        color='#1E8449', zorder=5)

ax.text(k_cx, cy + 1.75, r'$K\!=\!2$', fontsize=8,
        color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=5)

# 4. Arrows samples → Argmin
argmin_cx = 10.0
draw_arrow(ax, k_cx + 0.5, k_top_y, argmin_cx - 1.05, cy + 0.15, ls='--', lw=0.9)
draw_arrow(ax, k_cx + 0.5, k_bot_y, argmin_cx - 1.05, cy - 0.15, ls='--', lw=0.9)

# Argmin box
draw_box(ax, argmin_cx, cy, 2.0, 1.8, C['yellow'], C['yellow_border'])
ax.text(argmin_cx, cy + 0.4, 'Argmin', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color='#9A7D0A', ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(argmin_cx, cy - 0.25, r'$\arg\min_i \|a_i\!-\!\bar{a}\|$',
        fontsize=7.5, color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)

# 5. Arrow Argmin → CRM
crm_cx = 13.2
draw_arrow(ax, argmin_cx + 1.05, cy, crm_cx - 1.0, cy)

# CRM box
draw_box(ax, crm_cx, cy, 1.9, 2.0, C['orange_fill'], C['orange'], lw=1.8)
ax.text(crm_cx, cy + 0.55, 'CRM', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['orange'], ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)
ax.text(crm_cx, cy + 0.0, '615K params', fontsize=7, color=C['gray_text'],
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=5)
ax.text(crm_cx, cy - 0.4, '1.8 MB', fontsize=7, color=C['gray_text'],
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=5)

# 6. Arrow CRM → Refined Action
ref_cx = 16.5
draw_arrow(ax, crm_cx + 1.0, cy, ref_cx - 1.0, cy)
ax.text((crm_cx + ref_cx) / 2, cy + 0.35, r'$+\;\delta_a$', fontsize=8.5,
        color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=5)

# Refined Action box
draw_box(ax, ref_cx, cy, 1.9, 1.5, C['green_fill'], C['green'], lw=1.5)
ax.text(ref_cx, cy + 0.2, 'Refined', fontsize=9.5, fontfamily='serif',
        color='#1E8449', ha='center', va='center', zorder=5, fontweight='bold')
ax.text(ref_cx, cy - 0.25, 'Action', fontsize=9.5, fontfamily='serif',
        color='#1E8449', ha='center', va='center', zorder=5, fontweight='bold')

# obs features arc
ax.annotate('', xy=(crm_cx, cy - 1.05),
            xytext=(vla_cx, cy - 1.45),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->,head_width=0.12,head_length=0.18',
                           color=C['gray_text'], lw=0.8, linestyle='--',
                           connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.35'), zorder=2)
ax.text((vla_cx + crm_cx) / 2, cy - 2.5, 'obs features', fontsize=7.5,
        fontstyle='italic', color=C['gray_text'], ha='center', va='top', zorder=5)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Panel (b) — Adaptive Gating
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_b
ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
ax.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)
ax.axis('off')

ax.text(0.15, 10.0, '(b)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='serif',
        color=C['navy'], va='top')
ax.text(5.0, 10.0, 'Adaptive Gating', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold',
        fontfamily='serif', color=C['navy'], va='top', ha='center')

# Diamond
d_cx, d_cy = 5.0, 7.3
d_ry, d_rx = 1.2, 1.5
diamond = Polygon([
    (d_cx, d_cy + d_ry),

ax.add_patch(diamond)
